Hi all,

Thanks for joining the weekly follow-up thread. Two parallel asks coming out of Friday's cross-functional sync:

1) QBR readiness: Acme wants a short packet with product metrics + latency/cost highlights by next Wednesday (2028-07-04). I attached the working checklist (QBR_ready_checklist_v3.xlsx) — please fill the shaded rows for your areas. Key asks:
  - Product: feature adoption by cohort (30/60/90-day), launch gaps
  - Infra: p50/p95 latency, avg cost/token, any recent infra regressions
  - CS: support tickets closed vs open for top accounts

2) Exception triage: we need closure paths for the three live exceptions in the rollup (exceptions_rollup_20280701.pdf). Short-term runbooks or owner + ETA are sufficient.

Quick owners (proposed):
  - Product metrics table: Marissa
  - Latency / cost slice: Vivek + Lauren (infra + SRE)
  - Exception triage: Karthik (exceptions 1 & 3), Irene (exception 2 — billing mismatch)

Please reply inline with one-line commitments (owner, deliverable, ETA) so I can consolidate into the packet. I plan to send the compiled packet to Jordan (Acme) and their procurement contact by EOD Wednesday.

Attachments: QBR_ready_checklist_v3.xlsx (worksheet), exceptions_rollup_20280701.pdf (summary)

Thanks — Irene
Irene Choi
